title: Black Oak Golf Course
gap: Price for green fees not stated
blurb: Black Oak Golf Course is a nine-hole golf course measuring 3,163 yards with two par 3's, five par 4's, and two par 5's. The course features manicured fairways, tiered Poanna greens, and a signature par 3 hole over water. It has undergone improvements including removal of rocks, concrete paths, and a driving range.
